entities.summary: Tovsta Mohyla is an ancient Scythian burial mound or kurgan. In 1971 treasure was discovered in the kugan by the Ukrainian archaeologist Borys Mozolevskyi. The site is located in southern Ukraine near the city of Pokrov, in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast.
